title: TLS cert expiry: read NotAfter and emit WARN/ERROR log events
description: At startup, parse NotAfter from each configured TLS cert (reader, transit, mail, smtp) using rustls-pemfile. Emit event=cert_expiry_warning WARN if days_remaining <= 30, ERROR if <= 7. Fields: path, days_remaining, expires_at (ISO8601). Blocked on: stoa-da4c51f7.
